info.name: Get current or forecast weather data based on given locations,  including over 200,000 cities around the world.

params.name: longitude
params.description: The longitude of location you want to query for.

params.name: latitude
params.description: The latitude of location you want to query for.

params.name: dataType
params.description: Parameter to specify weather data type. "daily" support 1-day step for up to 16 days weather data, which is useful for long-term forecast. "5day_3hour" support 3-hour step for 5 days weather data, which is useful for short-term forecast

params.name: units
params.description: The units of measurement. Temperature will be given in Celsius for "metric" and in Fahrenheit for "imperial". The default value is "metric". Choose a proper value according to the measurement convention of the location you query.

params.name: count
params.description: The count of weather item want to return. Only works when data type is "daily" or "5day_3hour"

items.docs: With a simple weather query, the plugin delivers weather details, including a description of the weather conditions, temperature, humidity, rain probability, wind speed, and atmospheric pressure.
